Book formatting

Practical publishing support for the book you have written.

Discuss your project ↗

Finishing a manuscript brings a new set of decisions: the format, cover, print files, ebook presentation and publishing setup. I help independent authors work through those requirements and bring the agreed pieces together.

Based in Poole, supporting clients in Bournemouth and across Dorset. Working remotely throughout the UK and worldwide.

FOR INDEPENDENT AUTHORS

From manuscript to publishing assets.

You might need one defined task, such as book formatting or a cover, or support across several parts of publication. I can work with a new project or assess what needs adjusting in existing files.

The requirements depend on the edition and platform. A paperback cover, an ebook cover and the interior of a print book are different deliverables. Trim size, page count, paper choice and printer specifications affect the files, so we establish the intended formats before production.

Alongside the book itself, I also work on author branding, bios, blurbs and websites. Those can be separate commissions or part of an agreed publishing package.

Publishing services

  • Book interior formatting
  • Book cover design and technical refinement
  • Amazon KDP setup support
  • Publishing assets for agreed formats
  • Author bios, blurbs and branding
  • Author websites and digital presence

Agree the edition before preparing the files.

Send the manuscript, approximate word or page count, intended formats and the platform or printer you plan to use. If you already have a cover, include the available source files and any relevant rights or licensing information.

We agree what is included: for example, interior formatting for a specified trim size, a paperback cover wrap or a separate ebook cover. Changes to the manuscript, page count or production specification after layout can affect the scope.

Formatting, design and publishing are different jobs.

Formatting concerns the presentation of the text and the production file. It does not automatically include editing or proofreading. Cover work and platform setup are also specified separately unless included in your package.

Formatting starts from £150, print-wrap and ebook cover design from £250 and KDP setup from £125. Formatting and cover packages start from £375, and complete publishing packages from £550. The quote confirms the editions, deliverables, revision scope and costs. Platform acceptance and book sales cannot be guaranteed.

Before we start.

Can you help with Amazon KDP?

Yes. I offer formatting, cover work and KDP setup support as agreed services. Tell me which editions you intend to publish and what work has already been completed.

Is proofreading included with formatting?

Not automatically. Formatting and proofreading are different tasks. Any editing, proofreading or copywriting needs to be expressly included in the quote.

What if I already have a cover or formatted manuscript?

Send the current files and the changes you need, plus the printer or platform specifications. I will assess the work required before quoting.

Do print and ebook editions need separate preparation?

They should be scoped as separate deliverables. A print interior has a fixed page layout for an agreed trim size, while an ebook needs preparation for its intended digital format. Tell me which editions and platforms you plan to use, so the quote identifies the files and checks included for each.

Why confirm the manuscript and print specification before formatting?

The manuscript, trim size, paper and printer requirements affect the interior and cover work. Later changes can alter pagination and require further production work. Send the latest manuscript and the specifications you have; we agree what is ready for layout and how subsequent changes will be handled before production starts.

DEFINED STARTING SCOPES

What the starting price covers.

Starting prices apply to a defined entry scope. Your written quote confirms the deliverables, client-supplied materials, included revisions, total price and any third-party costs before work begins. Larger requirements and work outside the agreed scope require a separate written quote and approval. Revised prices apply to new enquiries; existing agreements and previously accepted quotes remain unchanged. Dorset Division is not VAT registered and does not charge VAT.

Book formatting — from £150

Includes and deliverables: Interior formatting of one straightforward, text-led print edition at an agreed trim size, delivered as a print-ready PDF. The quote confirms manuscript length and layout complexity.

You supply: The final edited manuscript, required front and back matter, trim size and printer specifications.

Revisions: One consolidated production revision round within the supplied manuscript and agreed specification.

Outside scope: Editing, proofreading, ebook conversion, additional editions, complex tables or illustration layouts, and manuscript changes after layout are quoted separately.

Book cover: print wrap and ebook — from £250

Includes and deliverables: One cover direction using supplied or separately licensed artwork, delivered as a print-ready front, spine and back wrap for one agreed specification, plus a matching ebook front cover.

You supply: The title, author name, final blurb, publication details, final page count and printer template, plus artwork and rights information.

Revisions: One consolidated production revision round on the agreed direction.

Outside scope: Original illustration, additional concepts, dust jackets, hardback versions, extra printer specifications and paid stock licences require a separate quote.

Formatting and cover package — from £375

Includes and deliverables: The straightforward print-interior formatting and print-wrap-plus-ebook-cover services described above, for one manuscript and agreed print specification. Deliverables are the print interior PDF, print cover PDF and matching ebook front cover.

You supply: The final edited manuscript and all formatting and cover inputs listed above.

Revisions: One consolidated production revision round for the agreed package.

Outside scope: An ebook interior, editing, proofreading, platform setup, extra editions and subsequent manuscript or print-specification changes require a separate quote.

KDP setup — from £125

Includes and deliverables: Setup and upload assistance for one title in one agreed KDP edition, using publication-ready files. The agreed listing settings and handover are recorded for you to review.

You supply: An authorised KDP account, final interior and cover files, metadata, rights information and your approved pricing, territory and publication choices.

Revisions: One consolidated correction round on the agreed setup before handover.

Outside scope: Formatting, cover changes, copywriting, extra editions, advertising and ongoing account management require a separate quote. You approve publication; platform acceptance and sales are not guaranteed.

Complete publishing package — from £550

Includes and deliverables: One coordinated project combining the print formatting, print-wrap-plus-ebook-cover and one-edition KDP setup scopes above, with a final file and setup handover checklist.

You supply: The final edited manuscript, cover inputs, publication information and authorised KDP access described above.

Revisions: One consolidated production revision round across the agreed package before final handover.

Outside scope: The package does not include editing, proofreading, an ebook interior, additional editions, original illustration, marketing, printing or paid third-party services. Additional work is quoted separately.

A revision round means one collected set of feedback within the original brief. A new direction, additional deliverable or change to approved content is additional work and requires a separate quote. Corrections needed because agreed work was not supplied correctly are not treated as paid extras.
